Throw one named genuine gem j south, then create the next sleeping peaceful unicorn and scout its actual placement. Require grateful acceptance to establish the +2 named-gem Luck branch. Create awake peaceful unicorns instead. #wizgenesis and #wizmap use no game turn, so actual adjacent placement can still be scouted before the gem throw. C-only named gift 4: observed hero (10,15), adjacent unicorn (9,16), source-directed throw b. C-only named gift 5: observed hero (10,15), adjacent unicorn (11,15), source-directed throw l. C attributes prove Luck13, five grateful named-gem gifts, alignment10 and >3000 turns. Create four hostile sleeping goblins (source malign3 each) and scout their actual placement before source-credit kills. This raises alignment toward >=20 without peaceful kills or combat damage.
